mainBanner.subtitle: Cairo University's premier engineering society — where innovation meets excellence. Building tomorrow's engineers through projects, competitions, and community.

organizationParagraphs: ASME (American Society of Mechanical Engineers) is a globally recognized professional society serving over 100,000 members in 140+ countries. Founded in 1880, ASME facilitates collaboration, knowledge sharing, career enrichment, and skills development across all engineering disciplines.

The Cairo University student branch, one of Egypt's most active chapters, bridges academic learning with real-world engineering practice — equipping members with technical expertise, leadership skills, and professional networks.

cards.title: GLOBAL VISION
cards.description: ASME's vision is to be the essential resource for mechanical engineers and other technical professionals worldwide to develop their skills, knowledge, and professional practices across emerging and traditional engineering frontiers.

cards.title: OUR BRANCH MISSION
cards.description: Empowering engineering students with hands-on learning, industry exposure, and leadership development to connect academia with the real world.

cards.title: BRANCH VISION
cards.description: To be a top student organization promoting innovation, technical excellence, and leadership for future professionals.

cards.title: One Goal
cards.overlayBody1: We move as one. Every decision, every effort, every win — shared across the entire team. No silos, no solo missions. When one of us succeeds, all of us succeed.
cards.overlayBody2: Our unity is our greatest competitive advantage.

cards.title: Together
cards.overlayBody1: Growth is not a solo sport. We invest in each other's development, share knowledge openly, and lift each other higher. Real progress is collective progress.
cards.overlayBody2: We celebrate every step forward — big or small.

cards.title: With Ownership
cards.overlayBody1: We don't wait for permission. We take initiative, own our outcomes, and lead change from wherever we stand. Accountability isn't a rule — it's a mindset.
cards.overlayBody2: Act like an owner. Think long-term. Deliver.

achievements.title: Engagement Award

achievements.title: Best Section Globally

subTeams.name: EXTERNAL RELATIONS
subTeams.description: Connect ASME CU with the world beyond our team. Build relationships with companies, partners, and industry professionals to support our projects and events, create new opportunities, and open doors for our members. Be the bridge that turns connections into impact.

subTeams.name: OC & LOGISTICS
subTeams.description: Turn ideas into unforgettable events. From planning to execution, you'll help organize every detail behind ASME CU's activities and ensure every event runs smoothly from start to finish.

subTeams.name: HR
subTeams.description: Empower people to reach their full potential. Support member development, organize engaging activities, and help create a positive culture where every member can grow and succeed.

subTeams.name: Supply Chain
subTeams.description: Drive smarter decisions behind the scenes. Help coordinate projects, analyze data, and improve workflows while gaining hands-on experience in operations, documentation, and process improvement.

subTeams.name: IT
subTeams.description: Build the digital face of ASME CU. Help develop and maintain our website, improve user experience, and create a platform that keeps students connected with everything happening in the chapter.

subTeams.name: Photography & Videography
subTeams.description: Tell the ASME CU story through your lens. Capture the moments that define us and turn them into engaging content that showcases our people, energy, and spirit.

subTeams.name: Graphic Design
subTeams.description: Bring ideas to life through creativity. Design eye-catching visuals that shape ASME CU's identity, promote events, and make every campaign stand out.

subTeams.name: Marketing
subTeams.description: Tell the story that inspires others. Create campaigns, promote events, and produce engaging content that connects students with ASME CU and amplifies our impact.
